name: Kourou ELA-2
tagline: Primary Ariane 4 pad — flew every Ariane 4 mission (1988-2003)
description: ELA-2 (Ensemble de Lancement Ariane 2) at Kourou's Centre Spatial Guyanais hosted all 116 launches of the Ariane 4 rocket between 1988 and 2003. Its near-equatorial position gave Ariane 4 a substantial GTO performance advantage over launch sites at higher latitudes, anchoring Arianespace's commercial dominance in the 1990s. Decommissioned after Ariane 4 retired; ELA-3 (Ariane 5) and ELA-4 (Ariane 6) are its successors.
